coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, washing face and brushing teeth
Preparing and eating breakfast, making a hot drink with the kettle
Changing into work clothes and checking the phone for shift schedule and severe storm alerts
Commuting to work at the hospital
Working a clinical shift at the hospital, attending to patients and completing rounds
Taking a lunch break at work
Continuing hospital clinical duties, updating patient records and handing over notes
Commuting home from work through the severe storm
Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and tidying the kitchen
Taking a shower and getting ready for the evening
Checking storm updates, charging the phone and computer, and preparing for a possible power outage
Winding down, reading on the computer and setting an alarm
